<ic>To allow Edward Watcher and Lucifier son of Cyrus on behalf of the Empire to commission research in the Imperial Archives into the prophecies and True Liao visions of Abraxus. An ideal budget to be 5 Thrones. Report to be made available.<br><br>
''Proposed by Casinea, seconded by Morrow.''</ic>

===Overview===
* [[Historical research]].
* This was related to events that took place during a Past Life Vision.
* Passed in principle, with 4 votes against. No thrones allocated.

===Date===
* Passed Spring 377YE (Event Two 2013).

===Cost===
* 5 Thrones

===Progress===
* Complete, funded privately.

===Campaign Outcome===
* A report into the life of Abraxus was compiled and [[Abraxus|made public]].
